name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.5 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 4 visits over 25 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 19 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 25 hours starting 2025-12-08, at wavelengths from 1.65 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
